sources.snippet: Overview Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct is a 3.21 billion parameter instruction-tuned language model developed by meta-llama and released September 25, 2024. This auto-regressive transformer uses Grouped-Query Attention (GQA) for efficient inference and handles multilingual text input and output with a 128,000 token context window.
